The '''Ministry of Finance''' was the ministry of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="LoNH" /> led by the [[Finance Minister]]. The first holder of that title was [[Gahg]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|307|Gahg}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="DT1 Date">The date of [[Dark Times 1|''Dark Times'' 1]] is established internally in relation to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> Among his first tasks was the [[Imperialization/Legends|annexation]] of worlds previously associated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Members of the [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] [[Species/Legends|species]] were valued by the Ministry of Finance for their ability to navigate the large amounts of [[Paper/Legends|paperwork]] and complex information systems required for the Ministry of Finance's [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning bureaucracy.<ref name="LoNH" />
